_meta.opis: Laički opisi 18 poznatih vrsta iz baze, napisani iz opšteg znanja, bez gledanja kartica iz knowledge_base.json. Gruba provera rada sa rečnikom običnog korisnika; mali skup, nije zamena za veći nezavisan skup.

upiti.0200: Bright red flowers with four papery petals, often with a black blotch at the base, growing in wheat fields; hairy stems and a round seed capsule.
upiti.0011: Yellow star-shaped flowers with many stamens; when you hold a leaf up to the light it seems to have tiny holes; small black dots on the petals.
upiti.0225: Low creeping plant in lawns with three rounded leaflets, often with a pale V-shaped mark, and white round flower heads.
upiti.0112: Clover with pinkish purple round flower heads and three leaflets with a pale crescent mark, common in meadows.
upiti.0203: Flat white umbrella-shaped flower cluster with one dark purple flower in the middle; feathery finely divided leaves; the cluster curls into a nest when it goes to seed.
upiti.0035: Bright orange daisy-like flowers, sticky aromatic leaves and curved hooked seeds.
upiti.0172: Small grey-green shrub with narrow leaves and spikes of small purple fragrant flowers.
upiti.0126: Large white flowers floating on a pond with many petals and a yellow centre; round floating leaves with a slit.
upiti.0123: Very tall single stem up to two meters with big funnel-shaped pink, red or white flowers along the stem and rough rounded leaves.
upiti.0237: Small plant with white five-petalled flowers and three toothed leaflets, spreading with runners; tiny red fruits with seeds on the outside.
upiti.0031: Climbing vine twisting around supports, rough lobed leaves and green papery cone-like flowers.
upiti.0046: Low mat of tiny fleshy leaves on rocks and walls with bright yellow star-shaped flowers.
upiti.0420: Looks like a nettle but does not sting, white hooded flowers in rings around a square stem.
upiti.0122: Shrub with glossy leaves, bright orange-red flowers with crumpled petals and a thick fleshy calyx, and a round fruit with a crown.
upiti.0405: Thorny shrub with narrow silvery leaves and dense clusters of small bright orange berries along the branches.
upiti.0242: Big round pompom flowers in orange or yellow and strong-smelling, finely divided leaves.
upiti.0472: Low hairy plant with bell-shaped purple flowers and yellow stamens in early spring, later feathery silky seed heads.
upiti.0310: Sprawling plant with large rough lobed leaves, big yellow trumpet-shaped flowers and large fruits.
